title: Movie review: ‘Forgotten Island’ is a love letter to Filipino culture
summary: Drawing from Philippine mythology, music and pop culture, ‘Forgotten Island’ is a colorful DreamWorks adventure that feels surprisingly, wonderfully Filipino from beginning to end.
